newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares ease, seen out of steam.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares ease, seen out of steam.

text.p: Austrian shares closed slightly down in low volume on Tuesday and traders said the market lacked the impetus to carry prices higher in the short term after it failed to sustain a year-high touched mid-session.
The ATX index of 21 blue-chip shares closed 1.3 points down at 1,210.9, off a session high of 1,216.88. Overall, 10 ATX shares were up, 10 down and one unchanged.
February ATX futures were 0.3 points up at 1,211.1.

"In spite of a positive international environment, things don't look very bullish in Vienna," a trader said. He forecast February ATX futures would go off the board on Friday nearer 1,200 points than 1,220.
A second trader saw potential for a retracement in the ATX index to 1,200-1,180 points.
Selling pressure centred on energy suppliers OMV, EVN and Verbund while limited demand focused on cyclicals.
In continuous trade rubber maker Semperit was the biggest gainer, rebounding from recent losses and firming 6.41 percent to 605.5 schillings.
Brewer BBAG was the biggest faller, down 2.40 percent at 733 schillings.
The all-share Vienna bourse index finished 0.13 points down at 449.51. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
